title: Pattern matching with edits

problem.name: Pattern matching with edits
problem.statement_latex: Given $P\in\Sigma^m$, $T\in\Sigma^n$ and $k$, identify substrings of $T$ at edit distance at most $k$ from $P$, represented compactly as in the algorithm. Complexity counts character queries and processing time.
